ADJUDICATION COMPLETE. I re-derived every disputed point rather than voting; key checks run independently in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-multi-agent-environment/53da20a7-5af0-58c9-b6a4-3bdefd3e2c90/scratchpad/judge_check.py (exhaustive verification of the partition identity over ALL K!=5040 permutations of a 7-prime block mod 11 — i.e. against the true sigma-path law, not the set-partition abstraction — agreement to 1e-15; pairwise contour decay bound verified in all cases; binding-case exponent arithmetic verified symbolically), and I read Chen arXiv:2507.08296 directly (abstract + Theorem 1.4 confirmed verbatim: sum_{chi mod q} N(sigma,T,chi) <~_eps (qT)^{7(1-sigma)/3+eps}).

RESOLUTION OF THE THREE MAIN DISAGREEMENTS. (1) Jump-time/fixed-time (ATTACK's 'main technical debt' vs RIGOR's 'dissolved'): RIGOR is right. Conditioning on the fixed rank positions t_1<...<t_4 (deterministic for each pair (u,v)), the cell contents under a uniform permutation ARE exactly a uniform ordered set partition; the expectation is an exact multinomial coefficient extraction (my exhaustive check computed E directly over permutations and matched the coefficient formula, so ATTACK's de-Poissonization loss simply does not arise — ATTACK analyzed V1's label-interval route, which the repair discards). The CK^2 contour prefactor is the only polynomial loss and is absorbed by taking w_0 = C_3 log X with C_3 large. (2) Whether short-window savings are load-bearing (ATTACK yes, RIGOR no): RIGOR is right. In the repaired ledger, configurations with >=2 micro cells are counted trivially (<= C K^2 w_0^2 = X^2 polylog pairs, bias <= 1, contribution M polylog — I verified the count), and configurations with exactly 1 micro cell get all decay from big-cell/macro ratio characters; |t_psi|^n moments for short windows are never used, so ATTACK's marginal short-gap classes dissolve. (3) RIGOR's claimed X^{1/3} margin in the binding case: REFUTED — arithmetic error. The |T|=1, all-3-sigmas-bad class contributes count(K^3 w_0 = X^{3+o(1)}) x beta^3 x (qr)^{-1} = X^{-1} beta^3 X^{o(1)}; the target M X^{o(1)} = X^{2+o(1)} forces beta <= X^{1+o(1)} (beta = X^{4/3} gives X^3, a failure). Lemma 5.1's sixth-moment count beta <= C X log^3 X (which I re-derived: (2X)^3 < eta^2 X^4 <= qr, unique factorization, Chebyshev at (3K/4)^6) meets this with POLYLOG margin only. The theorem still closes, but the write-up must track polylogs in this one case; there is no polynomial slack there.

(1) STRONGEST HONEST THEOREM THAT SURVIVES (status: provable-sketch, all component lemmas proved, assembly a fully checked exponent ledger): Theorem RQM. For sigma uniform on S_K, with sigma-path centres P_j^s = A_X Q_j^s, pair sums, shell weights exactly as Paper II Sec. 3: (i) E_sigma[E_a^s] <= C(eta,rho) M (log X)^{C_0} uniformly for every integer 1 <= |a| < H; (ii) E_sigma[sum_a R_a^s/m_a] <= C M (log X)^{C_0} and E_sigma[F_X^s] <= C M (log X)^{C_0} (aggregate reciprocal-frame target in expectation); all constants effective. Proof ingredients ONLY: exact rank-conditioning partition identity, Cauchy-contour/Stirling decay bound, Gauss sums/CRT, orthogonality, unique factorization of <=3-fold prime products (sixth moment), elementary counting. No GRH, no explicit formula, no zero-density theorem (Chen 2507.08296 verified and available but optional, only for a beta = X^{o(1)} cosmetic strengthening). By Markov: all but an omega^{-1} fraction of the K! orderings satisfy the sigma-path aggregate target with loss (log X)^{C_0} omega. Honest scope (must be stated verbatim): the sigma-path centres are not primorials; this certifies the reciprocal-frame architecture on average over orderings and removes GRH from the B2-type model input; it says nothing about Fortune, PGD2, or the increasing order, and it relocates rather than shrinks the Fortune-relevant difficulty (adopt ATTACK A7's framing; V1's value claim (c) 'isolates derandomization as the entire remaining gap' overstates — a single order has zero entropy and the mechanism contributes literally nothing pointwise).

(2) RANKED REMAINING GAPS. G1 (only gap to a paper): complete assembly write-up — full case enumeration (rank ties/merged slots with |c_s| <= 2, empty W_0, tail-cell principal character, orphan slots, macro-cell position cases), the path-graph matching lemma for mixed good/bad patterns (mechanism verified: a free good sigma perturbs two adjacent slots, sum_sigma |c||c'| <= ||c||_2 ||c'||_2 = 1 by Cauchy-Schwarz, cost X^4 vs decay X^{-Lambda}, Lambda = c C_3/20 - 2 arbitrarily large), and explicit constants C_3, C_0 — with the binding-case margin CORRECTED to polylog-only (RIGOR's X^{1/3} claim must not survive into the manuscript). Estimate: 5-10 pages, days of work, low risk — I independently re-derived every dominant ledger class and each closes. G2 (recommended diagnostic): Monte Carlo E_sigma[E_a] at X = 60-200 with exact phase arithmetic against M(log X)^{C_0}; ATTACK's toy (X = 30-120, residual R_a ~ 0.01-0.03 M for both random and increasing orders) is already consistent; cheap. G3 (the wall, unchanged): derandomization to the single increasing order — the entire distance to PGD2. The method needs ~exp(cK) order entropy; nothing transfers pointwise. Tractable-looking sub-questions the theorem newly isolates: variance version E_sigma[(E_a)^2] << M^2 X^{o(1)} via the same machinery with ~8 cells (would upgrade to concentration over orderings), and degradation of the bound over structured sub-families of orderings. Neither touches the increasing order; difficulty: programme-wall level, no estimate.

(3) OVERALL VERDICT: WRITABLE PAPER-GRADE THEOREM (as a model theorem), conditional only on the routine G1 write-up — every load-bearing lemma is proved and independently verified, the ledger closes in all classes, no unproved arithmetic input is used, and the archive stop-rule is not triggered (the mechanism is order-entropy decay diagonalized by characters, with only COUNTS of non-cancelling characters needed at the critical length — no character-sum cancellation, no kernel restatement, no de-tensorisation resummation). It is simultaneously an honest dead end for Fortune itself: it certifies the architecture and eliminates GRH from the model input, and that is all. Recommend: write it (it is the first unconditional PGD2-type estimate in any model and the epistemically cleanest artefact the programme has produced), with ATTACK A7's honesty caveats in the discussion section, and pursue the variance/concentration sub-question of G3 as the only forward-looking mathematics it opens.

verdicts.reason: Confirmed AFTER RIGOR's repair, which supersedes V1's label-interval route entirely: conditioning on the deterministic rank positions of the <= 4 indices, the cell contents of a uniform permutation form exactly a uniform ordered set partition, and E[prod_s psi_s(W_s)] equals the multinomial-normalized coefficient extraction of prod_ell(sum_s x_s psi_s(ell)). I verified this exhaustively over ALL K! = 5040 permutations (K = 7, mod 11, six cell/character configurations including micro cells, repeated and principal characters; agreement to 1e-15) — i.e. against the true sigma-path law directly, so no Poissonization, concentration, or de-Poissonization enters anywhere. Coefficient norms verified: sup|c| <= C(qr)^{-1/2} (principal components strictly smaller: Ramanujan/phi), ||c||_2 = 1 (Parseval), ||c||_1 <= (qr)^{1/2+o(1)}.

Confirmed in the repaired pairwise form, which I verified line by line and numerically: |Phi(psi;n)| <= C K^2 exp(-sum_{s<s'}(n_s n_{s'}/K)(1 - t(psi_s bar-psi_{s'}))) via Cauchy's formula on |x_s| = n_s/K, Stirling (prefactor <= CK^2 for <= 5 cells), the exact identity |sum rho_s z_s|^2 = 1 - sum_{s<s'} rho_s rho_{s'}|z_s - z_{s'}|^2, and log y <= (y^2-1)/2; the exponent constant is 1 and the theta-uniformity works because only |sum_ell psi psi'-bar(ell)| enters. verdicts.claim: STEP 4(i)+(ii) (L2 orthogonality and the m <= 3 moment sharpening)
verdicts.reason: Both exact as stated. Orthogonality: block primes are distinct units mod qr (ell < 2X < H <= q), so sum_chi |sum_ell chi(ell)|^2 = phi(qr)K. Sixth moment: (2X)^3 = 8X^3 < eta^2 X^4 <= qr for X > 8/eta^2, so the congruence is an integer equality and unique factorization gives sum_chi |sum_ell chi(ell)|^6 <= 6 phi(qr) K^3. The sharpening genuinely stops at m = 3. This sixth moment is the ONLY arithmetic counting input the repaired proof needs: Chebyshev at threshold 3K/4 gives beta = #{chi : t_chi >= 3/4} <= 6(4/3)^6 phi(qr)/K^3 <= C_eta X (log X)^3, which I re-derived.

verdicts.claim: STEP 4(iii) (near-trivial character count O(1) down to eps = c/log X via explicit formula + log-free zero density, as the crux of the V1 assembly)
verdicts.reason: Refuted as stated, on two independent grounds both agents found and I confirmed. (a) Wrong in detail: at x ~ X, Q = qr ~ X^4, T = X the explicit-formula error (x/T)log^2(xQ) = O(log^2 X) is fine, but the dyadic zero-sum bound X^{1-delta} log Q log T caps the certifiable zero at delta ~ loglog X/log X, and the density count (QT)^{c delta} is then polylog (or X^eps), never O(1); eps cannot reach c/log X. (b) Strategically insufficient even if repaired: the V1 Steps 3+4 architecture needs near-trivial control at deficit eps_0 ~ log X/K ~ log^2 X/X to beat the phi(qr) ~ X^4 character entropy per slot, a factor X/log^3 X beyond any zero-density reach, and the L2 count at that threshold gives ~X^3 candidates with only X^{-2} coefficients — divergent. RIGOR's diagnosis of the exponent mismatch is correct and ATTACK agrees in substance. The repair (constant threshold 1/4 + sixth-moment count + micro/macro pairing) eliminates the need for 4(iii) entirely; the explicit formula and zero-density theorems appear only in an optional cosmetic strengthening.
